versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Extracts the main X/Twitter post or article content from an already open browser page.
- Filters out UI chrome such as sidebars, login prompts, reaction counts, and promotional blocks.
- Returns cleaned content fields: title, content (plain markdown-ish), excerpt, byline, siteName, length, and url.
- Designed for use when web_fetch is blocked or too noisy, especially on X/Twitter.
- Works by running a provided JS script via browser act evaluate.
